title: Technician tiles with no data keep their report link
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-A} (for example Admin ShopView), whose role has the Reports permission, at location {Location-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST No Clock 14 Oct A).
  • Your browser window is at least 1024 pixels wide at 100% zoom (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  • {Location-A} is a location made for this test, with no clocked time at all.
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top bar.
  2. Look beside the names of the Technician Efficiency and Technician Utilization tiles.
  3. Point at the report icon beside Technician Efficiency and read the tooltip.
  4. Click the icon.
  5. Go back to the Dashboard, point at the report icon beside Technician Utilization and read the tooltip.
  6. Click the icon.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: Both tiles show the grey "-" headline and the dashed empty-chart outline, and both still show the report icon beside their name.
  • Steps 3 and 5: The tooltip names the report the icon opens. Write the tooltip text in the result comment.
  • Step 4: The Technician Efficiency report opens.
  • Step 6: The Technician Utilization report opens.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9582 (Story 10, Report Drill-In), with SV-9576 (Story 4) and SV-9575 (Story 3); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850, version 48 (14 Oct 2026, 17:09 UTC, Chris Ward), S10-R1, S10-R2, S10-R4, S4-R12, S4-R18 and S3-E3 (unchanged since version 42); confirmed by from Chris Ward's answer 7 of 14 Oct 2026 to our question sheet: "No PRD change: every tile keeps its report link with or without data". The design canvas row 15 drawing shows these tiles without the report link; Chris Ward's answer of 14 Oct 2026 says that drawing is wrong, and we take the PRD and his later answer as prevailing. Source-verified 14 October 2026. Not yet checked against a build.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S10-R1: “Each KPI tile and the Sales by Customer tile shows a report link.”
  • S4-R18: “The placeholder changes nothing else on the tile. The headline and the supporting line show their usual values.”
  • S3-E3: “Billing Efficiency, Technician Efficiency and Technician Utilization are each a ratio. When the denominator for the selected range is zero, worked hours, clocked hours, or the sum of work-order and internal hours, the measure has no value for that range. It is not zero, and the tile must not show "0.00%", because no hours recorded and a genuine zero percent are different facts. The same applies to the Revenue tile's parts-versus-labor split when revenue for the range is zero (S4-N2 already gives that tile its fallback supporting line). Inside the Technician Efficiency calculation, a work order line with invoiced technician time but no clocked time contributes no split share rather than an infinite one. The tile headline reads exactly "-", a single hyphen, in grey.”
  • S4-R12: “A tile shows the empty-chart placeholder in place of its sparkline when fewer than two points in the selected range have a value.”
  • S10-R4: “Hovering a tile's report link shows a tooltip naming the report the link opens.”
  • S10-R2: “Selecting a tile's report link opens that tile's matching report.”
